The same-cut event remains unavailable at the decision cut.

Parity is typed and validates canonical six-component payloads, the state binding checks population/order/account heads, and the report blocks incomplete execution, fee, parity or account evidence before classifying the frozen supported/not-met/inconclusive/no-go variants.

The INT11 native fixture retains event and known clocks; venue-path construction validates ordered complete intervals, event instrument identity, book transitions, duplicate rows and feed-lag publication. The INT10 projection maps canonical quote IDs by retained provider sequence and all frozen outcomes use filled entry/exit records.
